dynamicCopyAudit12.zh: 当前任务已不存在或不可用，请返回任务列表。
dynamicCopyAudit12.en: This task no longer exists or is unavailable. Return to the task list.

dynamicCopyAudit13.zh: 前置依赖已被其他操作更新，请核对最新内容后再保存。
dynamicCopyAudit13.en: Dependencies have changed. Review the latest values before saving.

dynamicCopyAudit16.en: An item with this name already exists in this folder.

dynamicCopyAudit17.en: The destination folder no longer exists.

dynamicCopyAudit19.zh: 文件夹不能移动到自身或后代
dynamicCopyAudit19.en: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.

dynamicCopyAudit21.zh: 任务已不存在，请返回任务列表。
dynamicCopyAudit21.en: This task no longer exists. Return to the task list.

dynamicCopyAudit22.zh: 主任务投入由子任务汇总，请到对应子任务确认估算。
dynamicCopyAudit22.en: Effort is calculated from subtasks. Confirm the estimates on the relevant subtasks.

dynamicCopyAudit23.zh: 任务范围或估算已有变化，请载入最新内容后再确认；当前输入已保留。
dynamicCopyAudit23.en: The task scope or estimate has changed. Load the latest values before confirming. Your input has been kept.

dynamicCopyAudit24.zh: 预计投入数据无效，请重新核对估算。
dynamicCopyAudit24.en: The effort estimate is invalid. Review the estimate.

dynamicCopyAudit25.zh: 估算与当前范围或版本不一致，请重新核对后确认。
dynamicCopyAudit25.en: The estimate does not match the current scope or version. Review it before confirming.

dynamicCopyAudit26.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：表格内容不完整。
dynamicCopyAudit26.en: The file edit record is corrupted: incomplete spreadsheet content.

dynamicCopyAudit27.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：正文格式无效。
dynamicCopyAudit27.en: The file edit record is corrupted: invalid content format.

dynamicCopyAudit28.zh: 不能通过正文编辑转换文件格式。
dynamicCopyAudit28.en: Editing content cannot change the file format.

dynamicCopyAudit29.zh: 此文件格式不支持当前正文编辑，不能转换文件格式。
dynamicCopyAudit29.en: This file format does not support this content editor. The format cannot be changed.

dynamicCopyAudit30.en: A file editor must be specified.

dynamicCopyAudit31.en: The file modification time is invalid.

dynamicCopyAudit33.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：缺少文件或版本信息。
dynamicCopyAudit33.en: The file edit record is corrupted: missing file or version information.

dynamicCopyAudit34.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：修改历史无效。
dynamicCopyAudit34.en: The file edit record is corrupted: invalid revision history.

dynamicCopyAudit35.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：修改位置或前后值无效。
dynamicCopyAudit35.en: The file edit record is corrupted: invalid edit location or content values.

dynamicCopyAudit36.zh: 文件编辑记录损坏：当前版本缺少对应修改记录。
dynamicCopyAudit36.en: The file edit record is corrupted: no revision record for the current version.

dynamicCopyAudit37.zh: 文件编辑记录不属于当前文件。
dynamicCopyAudit37.en: The edit record belongs to a different file.

dynamicCopyAudit38.zh: 本地文件修改早于当前来源版本，已保留较新的来源正文，不能用旧版本覆盖。
dynamicCopyAudit38.en: Local edits are older than the source version. The newer source content has been kept and cannot be overwritten by an older version.

dynamicCopyAudit39.zh: 文件编辑记录与当前文件格式不符。
dynamicCopyAudit39.en: The edit record does not match the current file format.

dynamicCopyAudit40.zh: 缺少任务标识，不能读取或保存文件。
dynamicCopyAudit40.en: The task ID is missing. Files cannot be read or saved.

dynamicCopyAudit41.zh: 无法读取本地文件修改记录，已停止保存以保护原记录。
dynamicCopyAudit41.en: Local file edits could not be read. Saving has stopped to protect the existing record.

dynamicCopyAudit42.en: The record must be a file mapping.

dynamicCopyAudit43.en: The file IDs do not match.

dynamicCopyAudit44.zh: 本地文件修改记录损坏，已保留原数据并停止覆盖。
dynamicCopyAudit44.en: Local file edits are corrupted. The original data has been kept and will not be overwritten.

dynamicCopyAudit45.zh: 文件版本已变化，请重新打开最新版本后再保存。
dynamicCopyAudit45.en: The file version has changed. Reopen the latest version before saving.

dynamicCopyAudit46.zh: 文件格式已变化，不能覆盖现有内容。
dynamicCopyAudit46.en: The file format has changed. Existing content cannot be overwritten.

dynamicCopyAudit47.zh: 保存记录缺少已有版本历史，请重新打开文件后重试。
dynamicCopyAudit47.en: The saved record is missing revision history. Reopen the file and try again.

dynamicCopyAudit48.zh: 保存后的文件记录校验失败。
dynamicCopyAudit48.en: The saved file record could not be verified.

dynamicCopyAudit49.zh: 文件修改未确认保存，请保留当前输入并重试。
dynamicCopyAudit49.en: File edits could not be confirmed as saved. Keep your input and try again.

dynamicCopyAudit50.zh: 请至少填写一条完成标准。
dynamicCopyAudit50.en: Add at least one acceptance criterion.

dynamicCopyAudit51.zh: 当前任务已不存在，请返回任务列表。
dynamicCopyAudit51.en: This task no longer exists. Return to the task list.

dynamicCopyAudit52.zh: 只能编辑当前任务的直属子任务，任务关系可能已有变化。
dynamicCopyAudit52.en: Only direct subtasks can be edited here. The task relationship may have changed.

dynamicCopyAudit53.zh: 完成标准已被其他操作更新，请核对最新内容后再保存。
dynamicCopyAudit53.en: Acceptance criteria have changed. Review the latest values before saving.

dynamicCopyAudit54.zh: 第 {0} 条完成标准不能为空，请补全或删除这一条。
dynamicCopyAudit54.en: Acceptance criterion {0} is empty. Complete it or remove it.

criterionHumanUndoHint.en: Confirmed by a person · Click to undo
